definitions.explanation: The general level of prices of goods and services in an economy.

examples.japanese: {物価|ぶっか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{物価|ぶっか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
{物価|ぶっか}⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{圧迫|あっぱく}→圧迫：12013_appaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Rising prices are putting pressure on household budgets.
examples.notes: 物価上昇 = price increase, inflation

notes:
USAGE: {物価|ぶっか} refers to the general price level of goods and services, often discussed in economic contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {物価|ぶっか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧/⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ (prices rise/fall)
- {物価|ぶっか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (prices are high/low)
- {物価|ぶっか}⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧ (price increase)
- {物価|ぶっか}⟦{指数|しすう}→指数：20414_shisuu⟧ (price index)
- {物価|ぶっか}⟦{安定|あんてい}→安定：01703_antei⟧ (price stability)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦インフレ→インフレ：04848_infure⟧ - inflation
- ⟦デフレ→デフレ：04850_defure⟧ - deflation
